metadata.notes: Source-backed Stage 0 inventory. Initial per-item implementation states are historical; current offline calculation capabilities are supplied by candidates.candidate_capabilities and registry.readiness. No application eligibility or vehicle validation is implemented. UI step is not a tested change amount. Stored values do not prove effective consumer values.

requires: torque lateral controller active
LateralTorqueCustom > 0
effective FF path identified
items.path_notes: Custom > 0 activates all stored torque gains and resets the acceleration offset; live torque updates are ignored while Custom is active. Resolve actual linear/NNFF/NNFFLite/comma FF implementation before using a fitting formula. The linear interface divides lateral acceleration by this factor; normalized commands are not measured motor torque in N*m.

items.structural_blocker: Current torque update does not pass error_rate to PIDController.update; its default is 0.0 and D output is zero. Enabling a D path is a controller change outside the advisor.

special_values.0: Manual torque overrides disabled; eligible live torque updates may be used.

requires: lane path selected
items.path_notes: Context dependency outside the planned numeric recommendation scope. Active branch interpolates lane y at path_t * (1 + raw*0.01), so the effective value is a time-axis scale, not a fixed offset in seconds; the distance-shift branch is disabled.

requires: brand is neither hyundai (including Kia/Genesis) nor toyota
single-breakpoint variable longitudinal tuning path selected
openpilot longitudinal controller active
items.path_notes: Conditional path blocker: Hyundai/Kia/Genesis uses fixed Kp/Ki/Kf = 1/0/1; Toyota uses fixed 0/0/1 because its car controller closes another acceleration loop. Those brands ignore these Params. Other multi-breakpoint paths also bypass them. carOutput acceleration is not proof of final Hyundai SCC aReqValue; decode sendcan with the matching DBC or require final-output diagnostic evidence. Raw-to-scalar gain conversion is source-confirmed; a physical dimensional unit is intentionally unset because it depends on the selected error and controller path.

requires: valid lane-change gap policy and candidate lane/lead evidence
items.path_notes: Lane-change-specific factor, not an alias for the removed DynamicTFollow option; requires lane-change guard/path evidence.
Setting 10 means multiplier 1.0 at 100 km/h, 20 means 2.0; actual multiplier is 1 + (raw*0.1 - 1)*max(speed_kph,0)/100. This is not a percent delta or a renamed TFollowSpeedFactor.

special_values.0: No extra deceleration boost requested by this factor; baseline deceleration hold still exists.

items.path_notes: Dimensionless raw/100 scales an acceleration-dependent extra time gap (up to 0.50 s before multiplication) with release ramp; raw+5 does not mean final gap+0.05 s.

requires: discrete profile evaluated in actual driving mode and selected gap
valid stable lead and MPC-source qualification
items.path_notes: Discrete 0..5 profile, not a continuous percent or gain; TF override -1 is inheritance. Eco/Safe can cap the resolved level. Level 0 remains a real profile and must not be assumed to disable all preview behavior.

special_values.-1: Inherit the common LeadAccelResponse value before driving-mode clipping.

requires: normal ACC separated from independent SoftHold and vehicle hold
repeated stopping/departure and final output evidence
items.path_notes: Hundredths of m/s^2, negative only; consumer clamps raw -100..-50. Normal stopping and independent SoftHold paths differ; preserve CP.stopAccel and hold transitions. Do not change during stopping/hold transition. carOutput acceleration is not proof of final Hyundai SCC aReqValue; decode sendcan with the matching DBC or require final-output diagnostic evidence.

requires: normal ACC separated from independent SoftHold and vehicle hold
repeated stopping/departure and final output evidence
items.path_notes: Hundredths of m/s. Existing stored values and UI minimum raw1 must be preserved; do not force a historical minimum10 or convert the threshold to km/h. Do not change during stopping/hold transition. carOutput acceleration is not proof of final Hyundai SCC aReqValue; decode sendcan with the matching DBC or require final-output diagnostic evidence.

requires: normal ACC separated from independent SoftHold and vehicle hold
repeated stopping/departure and final output evidence
items.path_notes: Raw centimetres consumed as metres; contributes to following/stopping obstacle distance and is not the internal user_stop_distance state. Do not change during stopping/hold transition. carOutput acceleration is not proof of final Hyundai SCC aReqValue; decode sendcan with the matching DBC or require final-output diagnostic evidence.

requires: normal ACC separated from independent SoftHold and vehicle hold
repeated stopping/departure and final output evidence
items.path_notes: Signed centimetres consumed as metres by the traffic-stop obstacle adjustment; does not replace lead-follow, signal guard, independent SoftHold or driver-hold contracts. Do not change during stopping/hold transition. carOutput acceleration is not proof of final Hyundai SCC aReqValue; decode sendcan with the matching DBC or require final-output diagnostic evidence.

requires: actual lateral target source identified
independent lane/path position, roll and calibration evidence
items.path_notes: Signed centimetres added to planned path y before lateral MPC. Lateral planner geometry can be calculated even when controlsd uses model action directly; a path offset is not proof of a corresponding lane-free command change. Steering angle mean alone does not identify path offset.

requires: manual CustomSR override not selected
learned ratio and actual vehicle model sensitivity known
items.path_notes: Multiplier on learned steer ratio, not a change to physical steering gearing. Valid raw range30..200; invalid values fall back to100. A valid CustomSR takes precedence and bypasses this multiplier.

special_values.0: No manual ratio override; use learned ratio with SteerRatioRate.

items.path_notes: Initial inventory classified this as mode context. Offline calibration may adjust an already active manual ratio without crossing raw 10. The settings schema provides raw 0..300 in steps of 1; these are menu bounds, not validated change limits. Consumer selects finite raw*0.1 only when the resulting ratio >1; otherwise it uses the scaled learned ratio.
